title: Database connection pool saturation
symptoms: Rising p99 latency with requests timing out after a fixed interval
Proxy pool stats showing in_use equal to size with a growing waiting count
steps: Compare the pool size with the number of concurrent workers on every instance
Check recent deploys and config changes for concurrency or pool-size changes
Confirm the database itself has spare session capacity and CPU
Either reduce worker concurrency or raise the pool size within the database's session limit
Watch waiting count and p99 latency recover before closing
